## Coverage and exclusions

- Parsed with `syn` along each crate's module tree (`mod`, `#[path]`, inline modules, file-level `#![cfg]`); comments, strings and `'static` lifetimes cannot produce findings.
- `#[cfg]` is evaluated for `target_arch = "x86_64"`, `target_os = "none"`, `target_pointer_width = "64"` and each crate's resolved features. Any other predicate is `cfg-unknown` and is treated as active.
- Macros are **not expanded**. `macro_rules!` bodies containing a `static` token are listed as emitters (none), and every invocation of one is listed separately. Every other item-level macro and every `global_asm!` is listed because it may define storage this tool cannot see.
- Only primitives, `&str`, and shared references, slices, arrays and tuples of those, plus `fn` pointers, are exempt as syntactically immutable. No type name is trusted to imply or exclude interior mutability.
- Declarations of crates not linked into this profile are inventoried below but not required to be classified; their platforms are not qualified by this report.
